REVIEW: BLOCKED
Reviewed-SHA: 98deaf48cc45ef1a1f0eb255ced4f88f5ee4e5c1

Local run at this head: `npm test` 896/896 passed, `npm run check` passed, `npm run build` passed. The hosted `test` check is green on this head.

Findings:
1. **Merge conflict with main (blocking).** Merging into current `main` (6ab5d80) conflicts in `tours/app.css` and `tours/app.js`. Main has since landed #93, #98, #101 and #102, and they touch the Tours view. Fix: merge `main` into this branch, resolve both files, and rerun the suite.
2. `reports/share.js:77-80` (shortlist toggle). After a successful save, the UI changes only when `feedbackFor(item.property_ref)` returns an item. If the feedback payload has no row for that property yet, `render()` never runs, so the button stays on "Add to shortlist" / `aria-pressed=false` and a second click sends `shortlisted: true` again. Fix: create the local feedback row when it is missing (or re-fetch `/api/share/feedback` after the write) and then re-render.
3. `reports/share.css` (`.tour-flow g text:last-child` at 10px) and `tours/app.css` (`.feedback-flow text` at 10px). Both SVGs scale their viewBox (720 and 540 wide) down to about 330px at a 390px viewport, so the stage labels render at roughly 4-5px on a phone. This is the client-facing share page. Fix: raise the label size under a narrow-width media query, or use a narrower viewBox / stacked layout on phones.

Clean: no credentials or client data; opaque `projection_ref`/`property_ref` only; all rendering uses `textContent`; writes carry a stable idempotency key per unchanged payload; reduced motion is respected.
